source_title: 실시간 던전 파티.... 분노의 흑마 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
subtitle: 지능도 내 거, 방숙도 내 거! 가시구릉의 무법자 징기

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
가시구릉 지능 목걸이를
징기가 왜 먹어? 님 힐러임?
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with only a minimal thorny Razorfen dungeon stone floor touch. Slightly angled medium shot: on the left, Undead Paladin has her two-handed golden warhammer stowed on her back and casually holds up a glowing green caster crystal necklace with a sleepy smirk. On the right, Human Warlock (spellbook stowed at her waist) points in shock while her cute round purple Voidwalker companion floats beside her wide-eyed.

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 모든 주문 및 효과로 입히는 피해와 치유량이 증가합니다.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
하하… 가시구릉에
좋은 템 진짜 많이 뜨네요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. Over-the-shoulder side-angled view: on the left, Undead Paladin lazily shrugs with her two-handed golden warhammer stowed on her back. On the right, Human Warlock forces an awkward stiff smile with a nervous sweat drop, waving both empty hands to smooth over the mood while her cute floating purple Voidwalker companion sweats nervously beside her.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
어, 체력·방숙 탱 목걸이다!
…잠깐, 징기님 주사위 뭐임?
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal thorny dungeon floor touch. Dynamic low-angle shot: on the left, Undead Paladin (two-handed golden warhammer stowed on her back) tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold dice with round dot pips only (no digits) and snatches a heavy spiked steel chain tank necklace. On the right, tanking Orc Warrior holding a compact one-handed sword and sturdy round shield freezes mid-reach in stunned disbelief.

Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background. Extreme silent big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of the frame height: centered Human Warlock freezes in comic deadpan shock and simmering fury with trembling wide eyes, an angry vein popping on her forehead, and jaw dropped, gripping her small purple spellbook tightly while her cute round purple Voidwalker companion right beside her mimics the exact same wide-eyed horrified stare.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
지능에 방숙 목걸이까지?!
님 혼자 탱딜힐 다 함?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. Tilted dynamic medium close-up: on the left, Human Warlock (spellbook stowed at her waist) leans forward shouting fiercely and pointing at her teammate while her cute floating purple Voidwalker shakes its stubby fists angrily beside her. On the right, Undead Paladin (two-handed warhammer stowed on her back) lazily dangles both the glowing caster necklace and the heavy tank chain necklace from one hand.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
이중 특성 스왑용인데 뭐.
탱님, 다음 몹 안 잡음?
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal thorny floor touch. High-angle wide comic shot: on the left, Undead Paladin (two-handed golden warhammer stowed on her back) casually wears both the glowing green caster necklace and the spiked chain tank necklace layered around her neck with a sleepy deadpan expression. On the right, Orc Warrior holding her one-handed sword and sturdy round shield slumps forward in total defeat with a dizzy swirl above her head.
